description: This file defines a base class for custom secret managers in the LiteLLM framework, including abstract methods for reading secrets asynchronously and synchronously, with optional methods for writing, deleting, health checking, and environment validation.

classes.name: CustomSecretManager
classes.description: A base class for implementing custom secret managers, providing an interface for secret reading, writing, deletion, validation, and health checks.

methods.name: async_read_secret
methods.description: Abstract method to asynchronously read a secret from the custom secret manager.

methods.name: sync_read_secret
methods.description: Abstract method to synchronously read a secret from the custom secret manager.

methods.name: async_write_secret
methods.description: Optional method to asynchronously write a secret; raises NotImplementedError if not overridden.

methods.name: async_delete_secret
methods.description: Optional method to asynchronously delete a secret; raises NotImplementedError if not overridden.

methods.name: validate_environment
methods.description: Method to validate environment/configuration; by default, always returns True.

methods.name: async_health_check
methods.description: Method to perform a health check; by default, always returns True.

methods.name: __repr__
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the instance.
